items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] And Twanette, Twanette, something like that.

ctx.x: But I asked Piku's daughter about that music. I went there a couple weeks ago, and she said that she didn't think he had any of it. She'd never seen it. That Piku's first or second wife, I think he had about three wives before he died. I think his second wife had had it over on Leray Street when he lived there. Oh yeah, yeah, yeah. She'd never seen it after that.
And Twanette, Twanette, something like that.
Yeah, yeah. So I'm praying that music is all gone now.
